title: Algophony Final Score Set
description: Flat final score set for a soundscape. Provenance is stored separately on reports and score records.

artificiality_discriminability.description: Can the listener tell if this is real or generated? 5 = clearly identifiable, 0 = indistinguishable. Null when ground truth provenance is unknown.

disclosure_integrity.description: Proposed v0.2 provenance axis. How completely the generation discloses its synthetic origin: generator, operator, version, and intended use. 5 = fully disclosed and legible, 1 = opaque. Null when not yet scored.

homogenization_index.description: Proposed v0.2 homogenization axis. Degree to which the output averages distinct ecologies, accents, voices, or places into a default rendering. 0 = situated and specific, 5 = fully averaged. Lower is better. Null when not yet scored.

voice_consent_risk.description: Proposed v0.2 consent-risk axis. Risk attached to voice-like material whose provenance or consent status cannot be verified. 0 = no voice-like material or fully cleared, 5 = prominent voice-like material with unverifiable provenance. Lower is better. Null when no voice material or not yet scored.
